_intake_note: Opus subagent findings, 2026-08-19. Evidence-first inspection of shallow clone. Basis marks preserved. Condensed from the agent's full report; claims and evidence locators verbatim.
purpose: Neuro-symbolic mitigation of LLM confabulation in clinical Q&A: a chatbot answers questions about one patient's record; every answer is translated into first-order logic and checked against a hand-built formal theory of that record using the cvc5 SMT/theorem prover. Stated goal (README.md:17-30): label each response valid/invalid/unknown, NOT to correct it. Single-patient illustrative demo.

verification_layer.formalism_and_engine: cvc5 1.3.1 (pinned), logic ALL: many-sorted FOL with quantifiers, uninterpreted functions, Int, String, IEEE-754 binary64, and a custom 3-constructor datatype TFU (tfu_true/tfu_false/tfu_true_or_false). Unknown numerics reified as NaN; unknown diagnosis as tfu_true_or_false. rlimit 150000.
verification_layer.what_is_verified: Consistency-based entailment of ONE extracted formula against the theory. theory + {not phi}: UNSAT => 'true' (genuine entailment), SAT => 'false' (core.py:982-987); on unknown, fallback tests theory + {phi}. What is verified is the FORMULA, never the natural-language sentence.
verification_layer.on_failure: NOTHING happens. No refusal, repair, regeneration, or retry anywhere (grep zero hits). The verdict is a displayed string; both UIs render the contradicted (corrupted) answer to the user with a red X (app.py:36; StreamingMessage.tsx:155-157; assets/6.png shows a false patient name delivered with a red X). README.md:106 concedes enforcement is imagined future work. SOURCE_EXPLICIT.
trusted_weak_links: 1. NL->FOL translation is a single unverified Sonnet-4 call: no round-trip check, no consensus, no proof the formula means what the sentence said (interface.py:93-188; README.md:113 names the risk). The whole guarantee is conditional on an unverified neural step.

2. 'False' means 'not entailed', not 'refuted': SAT of theory+{not phi} proves only non-entailment, but is surfaced as a contradiction (core.py:984-986). Near-correct here only because CWA axioms decide almost everything in-vocabulary; unsound in general.

3. Consistency silently becomes validity: fallback branch returns 'true' when theory+{phi} is merely SAT (core.py:996-997) — an unsupported-but-non-contradictory claim is stamped valid. Reachable because rlimit is finite and quantified queries undecidable.
4. Extraction failure FAILS OPEN: 'unable to extract' or exception => prover skipped, answer delivered unverified (interface.py:320-337).
5. One formula per response: README says 'one or more WFFs'; code verifies exactly one (utils.py:202-215); multi-claim answers have unextracted claims silently unverified.
6. The parallel verification path INVERTS the verdict for the negated query (core.py:1018-1022 applied polarity-blind at 1068-1084); unused by default (in_parallel=False).

7. approx= tolerance predicate implemented, axiomatised, unit-tested but unreachable — never taught to the extractor. HEAD commit: 'add (approx= X Y); not hooked up yet'. Consequence: a truthful rounded answer ('75 years old' vs 75.84657...) extracts to (= age 75.0) and is flagged INVALID.

8. The verdict can be lost in transport: /api/chat returns the field as `validity` (models.py:48, main.py:159) while /api/chat/stream emits `valid` (main.py:248); the frontend only reads `valid` (ChatService.ts:65); the non-streaming client path drops validity/corrupted_response/extracted_logical_stmt entirely (ChatService.ts:326).

llm_layer.models: Three Bedrock ids, all Anthropic: extractor global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0; chatbot us.anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0; corruptor same Haiku. strands-agents==1.9.1.
llm_layer.role: (a) chatbot answers with the theory injected into its system prompt as PROGRAMMATICALLY generated natural language — the theory->NL direction is deterministic code, the one trustworthy translation in the system (core.py:99-141); (b) extractor emits one s-expression WFF; (c) corruptor deliberately perturbs the answer to demo the verifier — when corruption is on, only the CORRUPTED sentence is verified while /api/chat returns the UNCORRUPTED one as `message` (interface.py:320-321 vs main.py:155).

interaction_pattern: Theory built at import (10 hardcoded Facts -> core axioms + CWA axioms, rendered to English programmatically). Question -> Haiku chatbot -> optional corruption -> Sonnet-4 extractor (one s-expression) -> fresh solver + ENTIRE theory regenerated per query (no incremental solving, core.py:914-921) -> concatenate + checkSat on negated form first -> true|false|unknown + both cvc5 Result strings + timings streamed as SSE -> frontend shows answer with check/X/question-mark and expandable detail. The verdict is NEVER fed back to any agent.

key_concepts.definition: Fixed, non-contradictory set of WFFs representing one patient's record, never modified during a session.
Closed World Assumption materialised as universally-quantified axioms mapping every unasserted argument tuple to NaN (numerics) or tfu_true_or_false (diagnoses), rather than assumed by the reasoner.
Epistemic 'unknown' as a first-class value in the object language rather than a prover failure mode.
A relation whose value persists forward in time until overridden — diagnoses hold across intervals between observations.
Prove the claim by refuting its negation, because cvc5 refutes quantified statements far more readily than it proves them.
Deliberate fault injector so the verifier has an error to catch on a trivially-easy dataset.
fp64 chosen over Reals specifically because Reals have no NaN.

claims_selected.claim: cvc5 performs the verification; 'valid' means no contradictions between extracted WFFs and the theory.
The primary-path 'true' verdict is genuine entailment (UNSAT of negation).
The 'false' verdict is only non-entailment surfaced as contradiction.
On prover-unknown, mere consistency is stamped 'true'.
Verification failure triggers no refusal/repair/regeneration; the contradicted answer is still shown.
NL->logic translation is an LLM step and itself unverified.
Theory->NL (chatbot context) is programmatic, not neural.
No FHIR ingestion exists; the 'patient record' is ten hardcoded Fact objects.
The GitHub Actions test workflow never runs: file named tests.tml, not .yml.
CI that does run (GitLab) executes only doctests, not the 19 prover-semantics test_ functions.
The theory is fully rebuilt from scratch on every validity check.
The verification feature has zero automated test coverage in the frontend suite: 14 test files / 4,759 LOC / 248 it() cases, none referencing validationStatus, the verdict emoji, or corruption.

backend/pytest.ini is silently inert: it uses the setup.cfg header [tool:pytest] where pytest.ini requires [pytest], so testpaths/addopts/asyncio_mode are ignored and the async backend tests would not execute.
The clean answer is demoted below the corrupted one in the UI: corrupted_response becomes message.content while assistant_response hides behind a click as 'Raw chatbot response'.

resonances: Typed schema / ontology-gated writes: PRESENT in non-graph form — every predicate declared up front with sorted args/return and registered; the LLM's formula is gated against that declaration (unknown function raises; SUPPORTED_KINDS is a closed operator whitelist). A WFF outside the vocabulary cannot enter the solver. Weakness: rejection is an uncaught Python exception swallowed into valid='unknown' — a schema violation is indistinguishable from a prover timeout; nothing quarantined or logged as a typed rejection. Rejection of unsupported assertions: COMPUTED BUT NEVER ENFORCED — the sharpest gap for a malleus reading: the system computes exactly the judgment you would want (does the trusted KB entail this claim?) and does nothing with it; a verdict that never gates a write is a label, not a control. Closed loop: ABSENT — the architecture diagram draws the feedback arrow; the code never closes it ('the loop is drawn, not closed'). Grounded audit rationales: PARTIAL, and the best part is thrown away — the solver requests unsat cores and proofs, retrieves and logs the core term-by-term (core.py:383-386, 881-894), but the core is never attached to FinalSummary, never crosses the API, never reaches the UI. The per-claim citation trail into specific KB axioms exists, is computed on every UNSAT, and is discarded. Concrete small-surface improvement: plumb getUnsatCore() through to the response detail. Typed KG: NOT_ESTABLISHED (no graph, no ids, no persistence; KB rebuilt from scratch per query). Additionally the frontend facts pane caches permanently (FactsService.ts:51-54,168-171, clearCache never called), so the displayed 'KB' can silently diverge from the one being reasoned over. Explicit absence over silent defaulting: PRESENT AND GENUINELY WELL DONE — unknown-ness reified into the object language (TFU third value, NaN numerics, CWA as explicit axioms), full 3x7 test grid including 'unknown before first observation'. Absence modelled as data — the same instinct as crash-loud-on-missing-required. Undercut one layer up by the verdict collapse (weak links 2 and 3) flattening the three-valued object language into a true/false string.
